title: Improved Instruction Ordering in Recipe-Grounded Conversation

layout.note: A dashed recipe card with a photo at the far left; to its right three aligned columns of speech bubbles (User white, System #1 blue, System #2 red), one row per turn so every question is answered side by side; a fourth column of red error tags with short arrows sits at the right edge, pinned to System #2's replies.

lesson: Show failure types by running one conversation through a good and a faulty system in aligned columns, pin a short red tag with an arrow to each wrong reply, and colour each system the same on icon, title and bubbles.
